description: Fires when a piece is pinned, skewered, or x-rayed by another. Variant chosen by which piece is in front/behind and which (if any) is the king.

fact_glossary.front_piece_type: The closer piece on the line of attack

variants.pin_to_king: {played_san}. Pins the {front_piece_type} on {front_square} to the king.
variants.skewer_king: {played_san}. Skewers the king on {front_square} — when it moves, the {rear_piece_type} on {rear_square} is exposed.
variants.pin_front_lower: {played_san}. Pins the {front_piece_type} on {front_square} against the {rear_piece_type} on {rear_square}.
variants.xray_default: {played_san}. Lines up the {front_piece_type} on {front_square} in front of the {rear_piece_type}.
